Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
All hematological parameters are within normal limits except for mildly elevated platelet count and markedly increased platelet distribution width, which may indicate reactive thrombocytosis or platelet activation. No evidence of anemia or leukocytosis. Correlation with clinical context and possible follow-up of platelet parameters is recommended.
